sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Lightweight Ad-Monetized Mobile Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law inheritance, Constitution of Samoa 1960, statutory law, and Samoan customary law; international companies are governed by the Commonwealth-derived International Companies Act 2006 and common law principles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone bilateral investment treaty with a major capital-exporting state is currently in force for the hyper-casual gaming sector; investment protection is instead derived from PACER Plus and domestic foreign-investment legislation.
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), ratified by Samoa and in force since December 2020, covering trade in services and investment facilitation.
Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (Samoa acceded 2012); relevant GATS Mode 3 commercial-presence commitments.
Samoa-United States Tax Information Exchange Agreement, in force.
Samoa-Australia Agreement for the Exchange of Information Relating to Taxes, in force.
Samoa-New Zealand Agreement for the Exchange of Information Relating to Taxes, in force.
Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters, as amended, in force for Samoa.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act 2007 (as amended by the AML/CFT Amendment Act 2018); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Regulations 2007; Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT Directives and Financial Intelligence Unit guidance; International Companies Act 2006 as amended; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2011; International Companies (Fees) Regulations; and SIFA Beneficial Ownership Register directions applicable to licensed registered agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of each proposed director's, shareholder's, and UBO's valid passport or national identity card, together with proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authorized officer in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the originating state's competent authority where the state is an Apostille Convention member; otherwise consular legalization through Samoa's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and nearest Samoa diplomatic/consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original professional bank reference and AML/source-of-funds clearance letter for each UBO issued no earlier than 90 days before submission
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or financial institution maintaining the UBO's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original document accepted with direct bank verification; if not in English, notarized certified English translation is required and, when demanded by the registered agent, consular legalization or Hague Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing, certificate of incorporation, register of directors, register of beneficial owners, and constitutional documents of any body corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registrar or competent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the shareholder's jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member; otherwise Samoa consular legalization; all non-English documents must be accompanied by a notarized certified English translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, UBOs, signatories, and counterparties against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Samoa domestic sanctions list, OFAC SDN List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and reputable adverse-media/PEP databases. PEP status is not automatically disqualifying but requires senior management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, and enhanced ongoing monitoring for a minimum of 24 months. Any positive sanctions hit requires immediate refusal of service and a suspicious transaction report to the Central Bank of Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) International Companies Registry; name clearances are submitted by licensed international company registered agents through the SIFA corporate portal in Apia.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the administrative language of the International Companies Register. A proposed name must be in Latin script; Samoan diacritics and Latin-alphabet variations are permissible. Non-Latin corporate names, including Chinese-language trade names, must be submitted with a verified Latin-script transliteration which will become the operative statutory name. The registered agent must certify consistency between the beneficial owner's Chinese corporate identity and the Latin transliteration.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Finance, Financial Services, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Fund, Securities, Exchange, Brokerage, Clearing, Deposit, Credit, or any word implying regulated financial activity without prior written no-objection from SIFA or the Central Bank of Samoa.

Government, Crown, Ministry, Authority, Municipal, National, University, Institute, Chamber, Royal, Official, or any word implying sovereign, governmental, or institutional sponsorship without ministerial consent.
Words identical or confusingly similar to an existing Samoa domestic or international company name, a reserved name, or a registered trademark protected in Samoa.
Obscene, abusive, deceptive, or illegal words, or words likely to mislead as to the company's licensed status or business purpose.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection by the SIFA Companies Division, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file a Notice of Objection within 14 days stating the proposed name, the official grounds for rejection, and submissions distinguishing the name from conflicting registrations. SIFA must determine the objection within 10 working days. An adverse determination may be appealed to the Minister of Commerce, Industry, Labour and Immigration, and further judicial review may be sought in the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days. Name clearance fees are non-refundable; a fresh application may be submitted after correcting the objectionable feature.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for a standard low-risk International Company. A licensed Samoa registered agent must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa capable of receiving legal process and regulatory notices. The hyper-casual mobile game publishing and ad-monetization operations may be managed entirely remotely, and the registered office may operate as a virtual administrative address; no physical office staff or local gaming operations are required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low annualized likelihood of approximately 3% for a clean, low-risk ISIC 5820 company with no adverse indicators. The likelihood increases to approximately 25% if PEP exposure, sanctions screening hits, adverse media, or suspicious transaction reports arise. SIFA and the Central Bank of Samoa retain the right to perform targeted or unannounced inspections of the registered agent's premises and the physical registered office.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation fee (two name alternatives)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations and SIFA fee schedule.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing and certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation fee under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Prepaid first-year SIFA International Company annual license fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual license tariff for an International Company.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service, first year, including statutory registers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoa international company registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in the Samoa offshore corporate services market.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO identification, AML/CFT customer due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening processing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent's designated AML/CFT compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; service is mandated by SIFA AML/CFT supervisory expectations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of notarized shareholder/UBO documents, plus certified English translation of Chinese-language corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Originating state competent authority, Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, nearest Samoa consular post, and translation agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing government consular tariffs and market benchmark for certified translation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional drafting of incorporation application, corporate resolutions, governance documents, and basic AML/CFT policies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoa law firm or corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard International Company pre-incorporation work.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2017, ss. 2, 4, 8, 9, 10 and 12 (Samoa); read with Companies (Fees) Regulations 2017.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Incorporated Companies Registry Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form SIFA-IC-001) accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; incorporation may declare nominal capital of USD 1. No escrow account or capital deposit is required before registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber hereby adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association and subscribes to the initial share capital as stated in the Application for Incorporation, consisting of 1,000 ordinary no-par-value shares, allotted to the founding shareholder as of incorporation date. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be established at the address of its licensed registered agent in Samoa, and that the registered agent be retained under the Registered Agent Agreement. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed as first director, [Name] as Secretary, and the above person(s) be authorized to open bank accounts and execute all necessary statutory filings. Adoption by unanimous consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – online name reservation module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit name reservation request with proposed name, verifying absence of prohibited words and similarity to existing companies. Approved names are reserved for 30 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a fresh reservation with a distinctive alternative name or appeal to the Registrar within 14 days on grounds of mistaken similarity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent or local notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association compatible with International Companies Act 2017, specifying authorized share capital, director count, registered agent, and permitted purpose. Execute by the founding shareholder and initial director before a witness.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any defective clauses or signature gaps and re-execute the documents; no registry rejection is possible prior to filing if the agent confirms compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application and payment of statutory fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form SIFA-IC-001 together with signed constitutional documents through the licensed registered agent. Remit the official state filing fee of USD 250 and any agent service fee via SIFA-approved payment channels.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to SIFA query within 10 business days by providing explanatory statements or amended documents; the application is deemed withdrawn if unresolved after 30 days, requiring a refiling with a fresh fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of certificate of incorporation and corporate kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, SIFA issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique company number. The registered agent makes available the corporate kit containing the certificate, stamped memorandum and articles, share certificate book, and seal (optional).
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the issued certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction of any clerical discrepancy in the certificate under Section 12 of the Act; SIFA will reissue within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent in conjunction with the first board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt unanimous written resolution to approve share subscription, designate registered office and agent, appoint officers, adopt the company seal, and open bank accounts. File any required change of particulars with SIFA.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any inconsistent resolution by supplemental board resolution; late notification of officer changes is cured by filing a corrective return with a late fee of USD 20.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa) – Business and Investment Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no industrial operating license or manufacturing permit is required for pure digital publishing activities under ISIC 5820

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Samoa Environment Protection Agency – EIA Review Unit
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not applicable – administrative exemption for non-industrial virtual activities with no physical premises
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable – no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or solid hazardous waste generation occurs from server-based hyper-casual game publishing

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable – the company maintains no physical workplace in Samoa; fire safety certification, structural load inspection, and occupational workplace clearance are not triggered.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa, which absorbed the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) and the Customs Service with effect from 1 July 2024; sole national tax administration for the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003 (VAGST), the Tax Administration Act 2020, the Customs Act 2014, and the tax-exemption provisions of the International Companies Act 2020. Taxpayer portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (IRIS e-filing and TIN e-registration); physical registry: Taxpayer Services Division, Apia.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate under the International Companies Act 2020 (or register a foreign branch under the Companies Act 2001 if onshore activity is intended). Step 2: File MfR Form IRD-001 'Taxpayer Registration - Non-Resident/International Company' through the IRIS portal at https://www.revenue.gov.ws, accompanied by (i) certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation; (ii) certificate of good standing; (iii) register of directors and shareholders; (iv) appointment deed and power of attorney in favor of a licensed Samoan registered agent; and (v) apostilled passports of all directors. Step 3: The MfR issues a nine-digit Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) within 5 to 10 working days at no fee. Step 4: If the entity makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Samoa reaching the VAGST threshold, VAGST registration is effected simultaneously and the entity receives a VAGST registration number with a monthly or quarterly return cycle. Step 5: For an International Company on the tax-exempt path, no income tax or VAGST return is filed with the MfR; the IC files only its annual return with the Registrar of International Companies. Recommendation: obtain a TIN proactively even where no Samoan tax liability arises, because AdMob, AppLovin, and local banks require it for KYC and for issuing the Inward Remittance Certificate supporting export zero-rating.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa has no check-the-box, look-through, or hybrid-mismatch election; classification follows legal form. The International Company is a separate legal personality automatically placed in a statutory 20-year tax-exempt zone (renewable) under section 210 of the International Companies Act 2020, so no election is required to obtain exemption. Available elective mechanisms: (a) voluntary VAGST registration under section 10 of the GST Act 2003 to recover input tax, which is counter-indicated for a pure offshore ad-revenue business; (b) an onshore election recorded in the IC memorandum to carry on domestic trade, which submits the IC to standard corporate income tax and VAGST on Samoa-source supplies; (c) VAGST group registration under section 15 of the GST Act 2003 for related Samoan-registered entities; (d) designation of reporting currency and share-capital terms in the constitution; and (e) settlement elections under the International Trusts Act 2016. OECD BEPS Action 2 and CFC rules have not been enacted in Samoa; shareholders resident in high-tax jurisdictions remain exposed to their home country anti-deferral regimes on the IC passive income.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003, as amended and administered by the Ministry for Revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration applies to any person carrying on a taxable activity if the value of taxable supplies in Samoa reaches or exceeds WST 50,000 (approx. USD 18,500) in a 12-month rolling period; voluntary registration is available below this threshold. The threshold does not create nexus for an International Company whose ad-monetization services are supplied wholly to non-resident ad networks (AdMob, AppLovin) with no fixed establishment in Samoa; the statutory nexus test is the supply of goods or services in Samoa, and offshore software, advertising, and gaming revenue falls outside the VAGST net. A registered entity files monthly or quarterly VAGST returns through the IRIS portal.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable. Samoa does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, e-invoice clearance, or digital stamping regime as of the knowledge date. The MfR accepts paper or electronic invoices provided they contain the statutory particulars in the GST Act 2003: supplier name and TIN, recipient identity, sequential invoice number, invoice date, description, tax-exclusive price, VAGST amount and rate, or the zero-rating statutory reference. The IRIS e-filing portal applies to tax returns, not invoice-level clearance. Entities must retain the invoice register for 7 years for audit review.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The GST Act 2003 zero-rates the following supplies relevant to an ISIC 5820 hyper-casual gaming publisher: (a) exports of goods, provided the goods leave Samoa within 28 days of delivery to the carrier; (b) services performed physically outside Samoa; (c) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and where the services are not connected with land or goods in Samoa; and (d) services in connection with goods for export or international transport. Programmatic supply of advertising inventory and user-acquisition services for hyper-casual games to AdMob (Google Ireland) and AppLovin (Luxembourg and United States) qualifies under category (c): the recipient is non-resident, the service is the delivery of digital ad impressions to audiences outside Samoa, and consideration is remitted in USD from offshore ad networks. To sustain zero-rating, the IC must document: the executed ad-network contract; the non-resident status of the counterparty; per-period payout statements from the AdMob and AppLovin dashboards; and matching bank receipts. If the IC has no Samoan taxable supplies, it is not registrable and no VAGST return arises; where a VAGST registration is nonetheless held, the same documentation supports an input-credit refund, generally payable by the MfR within 60 days of a complete application.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CED) lodged in the Samoan Customs electronic system and attested by the Ministry for Revenue, required only when tangible goods (for example branded merchandise or physical game media) are physically exported from Samoa; not applicable to pure digital services; the export entry number must be quoted on the export invoice.

Bill of Lading or Air Cargo Waybill showing Samoa as the port of export and the foreign destination; for digital services this is replaced by the ad-network payout reconciliation report and server-side ad-delivery logs evidencing offshore consumption.

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Samoan commercial bank matching the invoice and the payment-rail payout from AdMob or AppLovin in USD within the applicable repatriation window, including SWIFT reference, value date, and FX conversion rate into WST.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The MfR may audit export zero-rating claims for up to 7 years after the relevant return period under the Tax Administration Act 2020. Substantiation is strictly documentary: contract, non-resident status certificate, payout dashboard, and Inward Remittance Certificate; proceeds not repatriated and matched within 180 days from the zero-rated invoice date are rebuttably presumed to be non-export revenue. Consequences of a failed or fraudulent zero-rating claim: (i) output VAGST is recaptured at the standard rate (currently 10%) from the original invoice date, with associated input credits denied and statutory interest at 12% per annum; (ii) a shortfall penalty of 50% to 150% of the tax understated depending on carelessness or willfulness; (iii) a late-filing penalty of WST 200 per month per return; (iv) criminal prosecution for fraudulent declaration with fines up to WST 10,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years; and (v) for an International Company, revocation of the 20-year tax-exemption status and potential deregistration by the Registrar of International Companies, with retrospective clawback of all exempted taxes for the audit period. The MfR applies substance-over-form and transfer-pricing analysis where shell-company indicators are present and may recharacterize a related-party ad-network payer to defeat artificial zero-rating arrangements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS); primary regulator for monetary policy, foreign exchange administration, and banking supervision under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, the Exchange Control Act 1973, and the Financial Institutions Act 1996. CBS licenses commercial banks as Authorized Dealers and administers exchange-control permissions, capital-movement approvals, and dealer margins. The Samoan Tālā (WST) is the only legal tender; USD is accepted only via approved Foreign Currency Accounts (FCAs).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: WST is a partially convertible, managed-float currency. Current-account transactions (ad-tech receipts, platform commissions, server costs, user-acquisition spend) are processed by Authorized Dealers against underlying invoices/contracts without CBS pre-approval. Capital-account transactions — share-capital injection, shareholder loans, repayment of intercompany debt, and dividend outflow — require CBS prior approval or a standing dealer exemption. An International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 is tax-exempt on foreign-source gaming income, but profit remittance is still a controlled capital movement: CBS requires audited financials and a Samoa Revenue Authority clearance for large dividend wires (typically above WST 200,000). Non-resident owners may retain earnings in a CBS-approved USD FCA; conversion to WST is priced at the CBS daily reference rate plus a dealer spread. There is no statutory queueing or dual-rate mechanism; convertibility is transaction-specific and evidence-driven.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: CBS exchange-control policy requires export proceeds — including digital-services receipts from hyper-casual game advertising (AdMob/AppLovin) — to be repatriated to a licensed bank in Samoa within 90 days from the invoice/payment date. Unless a CBS-approved FCA is in force, the mandatory surrender ratio is 100%: the dealer converts USD to WST at the prevailing rate upon receipt. Where an FCA is approved, proceeds may be retained in USD to match USD-linked ad-tech payables, subject to quarterly CBS reconciliation and a documented retention justification. Any extension, offset, or netting of receivables requires a prior CBS exemption; late receipt beyond 90 days must be disclosed and may attract administrative review and monetary penalty under the Exchange Control Act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (WST) for the registered share-capital injection; USD Foreign Currency Account (FCA) for AdMob/AppLovin receivables and CBS-approved inward transfers. SWIFT: ANZBWSSW.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific Samoa Limited (BSP)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Settlement Account and WST Transaction Account for daily treasury sweeps; strongest Pacific correspondent network for USD wires. SWIFT: BOSKWSWS.
Operational WST account; no dedicated non-resident FCA product for International Companies; acceptable as a secondary disbursement account.
Retail WST account; state-owned bank with discretionary risk appetite for offshore International Companies; unlikely to host an IC treasury account.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Restricted. Samoa does not maintain an e-money or fintech-sandbox licensing regime; non-bank payment service providers require CBS licensing under the Financial Institutions Act 1996, and offshore EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) are not Authorized Dealers. An EMI may function only as an inbound USD aggregation wallet between AdMob/AppLovin and the Samoan bank account; it cannot perform WST conversion, and the 'double-hop' of funds may trigger enhanced AML review. Recommended approach: use an EMI for the first 90 days of operations only, then route payouts directly to the ANZ/BSP USD FCA; any retained EMI balance must be covered by a tri-party acknowledgment executed with the IC's Registered Agent.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hybrid — video-first with one physical meeting. CBS AML/KYC under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) requires identification of all directors, the authorized signatory, and the ultimate beneficial owner. All major banks require a live video interview with the signatory director; the corporate application must be introduced by a Samoa-licensed Registered Agent (trustee or law firm) with certified constitutional documents. A physical visit to Apia for the first authorized signatory is effectively mandatory; subsequent signatories may be onboarded remotely by video once the corporate profile is established. The bank's Account Approval Committee may waive the physical meeting for a Low_Risk_Standard gaming IC if the Registered Agent holds statutory custody of the corporate seal and board minutes, and the UBO provides a notarized ID and proof-of-address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of beneficial ownership: an IC held through a Hong Kong/Singapore intermediary or discretionary trust with no searchable public registry, raising suspicion of layered ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Unbroken corporate-ownership chart from the IC to each ultimate natural person; Certificate of Incumbency for every intermediate entity; trust deed summary and trustee declaration; CBS legal-person beneficial-ownership return under MLPA 2007; Registered Agent's compliance certificate; notarized passports and proof of domicile for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ad-tech flow mismatch: AdMob/AppLovin payouts that are high in volume but inconsistent with the declared hyper-casual publishing activity, indicating possible pass-through or unlicensed money transmission.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Published-title list from Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect; 12-month revenue dashboards from AdMob and AppLovin; executed publisher agreements (Google AdSense Online Terms; AppLovin Publisher Agreement); monthly payout statements showing publisher-account and bank-account naming alignment; an ISIC 5820 business narrative and product-market briefing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid circular flows: funds credited and onward-transferred within 48-72 hours to third-party developer studios in East Asia, mimicking layering or unlicensed remittance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved cash-flow calendar; executed development, licensing, and user-acquisition contracts with exact commercial terms; standing-payee whitelist pre-cleared by the bank's compliance team; 60-day payment-velocity report; undertaking that all outbound payments will be settled via MT103 with '/RFB/' reference narratives tied to invoices.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sequence: (1) obtain CBS 'no-objection' letter for inward direct investment (capital-account approval), filing the IC's Certificate of Incorporation, shareholders' resolution, and share allotment; (2) execute share subscription and issue share certificates under the International Companies Act 1987; (3) remit by SWIFT MT103 from the parent/UBO bank to ANZ Bank Samoa (SWIFT ANZBWSSW) or BSP Samoa (SWIFT BOSKWSWS) for credit to the IC's USD FCA or WST Capital Escrow Account; (4) instruct the dealer to convert the required operational tranche to WST at the CBS reference rate for local opex; (5) submit CBS verification form and the Registered Agent's Deed of Compliance within five business days. The wire narrative must read: 'FDI — ISIC 5820 hyper-casual game publishing — capital subscription', with the share register updated and bank statements retained as the complete audit trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 beneficiary transfers for developer royalties, user-acquisition spend, server hosting, platform commissions, and Registered Agent fees; MT202 COV is used only for nostro settlement. Secondary rail: irrevocable, confirmed Letters of Credit (UCP600) issued by ANZ/BSP Samoa and advised through an Australian or Chinese confirming bank for outsourced game-development blocks above USD 250,000. All outbound wires must reference the underlying contract and the pre-approved payee registry; monthly outbound flows above WST 200,000 require the dealer to submit CBS transfer documentation. Sanctioned-jurisdiction payees are prohibited; AdTech traffic sourced from OFAC/UN-sanctioned geographies must be contractually excluded from the monetization stack.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable WST/USD FX forward (tenor up to 12 months) under ISDA/CSA with ANZ Bank Samoa or BSP Samoa; requires an underlying eligible current-account exposure and CBS 'no-objection' for tenors exceeding 12 months.

USD/WST cross-currency swap executed through the dealer bank's offshore booking centre; permitted for structural hedging of the initial capital injection and long-term licensing liabilities, subject to CBS prior approval.

Offshore USD/WST non-deliverable forward (NDF) cash-settled in USD with a Singapore or Hong Kong bank; acceptable as a hedge for USD-denominated AdMob/AppLovin receivables and classified as a non-capital transaction not requiring CBS approval, provided no WST is delivered at maturity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form IC-AR) of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month following each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late-filing penalty of WST 500 (~USD 185); continued default after the Registrar's 3-month notice period triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 2012.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee (Government Franchise Fee) Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa, remitted through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date, unless the graduated fee schedule applies by gross asset tier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 10% of the annual fee; an unpaid fee continuing beyond the statutory notice period exposes the company to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation (UBO Declaration) with Shareholding Transfer Updates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa (central beneficial ownership register under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership Register) Act 2020)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Certified annually with the Annual Return; any transfer of shares causing a change of beneficial ownership must be declared within 14 days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fines for late or false BO filings, with daily continuing default penalties; non-compliance may support strike-off action and director personal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office / Registered Agent Retention Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Samoa, with change notice to the Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary date; change of agent or registered office must be filed within 14 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a Samoan registered office and agent may be treated as the company ceasing to carry on business, enabling the Registrar to strike it off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory audit is mandatory only for a 'large international company', i.e., one with consolidated annual revenue exceeding WST 15 million (~USD 5.5 million) or consolidated total assets exceeding WST 30 million (~USD 11 million); a small or medium IC may also be audited if shareholders holding at least 10% of the voting rights request it or the Registrar orders one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) are the benchmark framework; Samoa-accepted International Company GAAP is permitted if it yields a true and fair view. Financial statements of an audit-exempt IC are not publicly filed with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at its Samoan registered office identifying each registrable person, i.e., any individual or entity with direct/indirect ownership or control of more than 10% of shares or voting rights. The annual confirmation is embedded within the Annual Return, and any shareholder transfer altering ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported to the Registrar within 14 days of the transfer. Failure to keep the BO register current is an offence under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership Register) Act 2020.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholder and Director Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 – 10,000 (voluntary or group-consolidation driven; not statutory below the large-company threshold)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (standard Samoan corporate income tax rate under the Income Tax Act 2012; International Companies are exempt from this rate on foreign-source income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company (IC) Exemption: 0% on non-Samoan-source income. An IC may elect to be assessed at a special rate of 9% on chargeable income solely to obtain a Tax Residence Certificate for treaty and banking purposes. No capital gains tax, no stamp duty on IC share transfers, and no exchange control restrictions on IC foreign currency accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Income Tax Return for Companies (Form ITR-C) or Nil-Return Declaration for International Companies (Form IC-NIL), filed through the Samoa Ministry of Revenue e-Filing Portal (Taxpayer Online Services).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual self-assessment return; quarterly provisional tax instalments are required only where the IC has elected the 9% taxation regime.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the end of the income year (income year is the calendar year; deadline 31 March). An extension of up to 3 months may be granted by the Ministry of Revenue on written application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Ministry of Revenue TIN; a tax-exempt IC may quote its International Company registration number if no TIN has been allocated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income Year Commencement and End Date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 1 January to 31 December unless a substituted year-end has been approved by the Ministry of Revenue.
Aggregate worldwide income. For a tax-exempt IC, exclude all foreign-source game publishing and ad-monetization income.
Record the IC foreign-source income exemption, including AdMob and AppLovin payout income, reimbursed IP license fees, and offshore royalty inflows.
Deduct arm's-length operating costs only; no deduction is allowed for dividends or distributions to shareholders, and no deduction is permitted for payments lacking economic substance in Samoa.
For a tax-exempt IC, state NIL. An IC electing the 9% regime computes taxable income after allowable deductions at arm's length.
Multiply Box 6 by 27%. For an IC electing the special regime, apply the 9% rate and attach the Notice of Election to be Assessed at 9%.
Claim credits for foreign withholding taxes only where the IC is subject to Samoan tax on the same income and holds a valid Tax Residence Certificate.
Disclose related-party transactions, including AdMob/AppLovin payout arrangements and IP licensing with affiliated game studios, where aggregate value exceeds WST 1,000,000; attach the Local File.
Executed by the Samoa-resident registered agent, or by a director for a Nil-Return Declaration, attesting under penalty that the foreign-source income exemption is correctly claimed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: default penalty of 10% of the tax assessed (minimum WST 500); late payment interest at 1.5% per month compounded. Intentional non-filing of an IC declaration triggers loss of the IC exemption, re-assessment at 27%, and a 150% shortfall penalty.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory non-resident dividend withholding tax under the Income Tax Act 2012. Dividends paid by an International Company out of exempt foreign-source income are outside the Samoan withholding net (0%), provided the IC derives no income from Samoan sources.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief requires a Tax Residence Certificate. Procedure: (i) the IC files a Notice of Election to be taxed at 9% on chargeable income; (ii) the Ministry of Revenue assesses the IC and issues a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate; (iii) the beneficial owner submits the TRC, a formal statement of beneficial ownership, and a residency certificate from its own tax authority to the payer; (iv) the payer applies the reduced DTA rate. Samoa maintains a limited comprehensive DTA network (principally Australia and New Zealand) with reduced dividend, interest, and royalty rates.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding: interest 15%, royalties 15%. Under the Australia and New Zealand DTAs, treaty rates of 10% apply for interest and royalties when the recipient is treaty-resident and the TRC protocol is completed. A tax-exempt IC is generally not entitled to treaty rates because it is not a Samoan tax resident.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 (approximately USD 360,000): aggregate related-party revenue or costs in an income year triggers mandatory Local File documentation. Master File documentation is required where the multinational group has consolidated turnover exceeding WST 100,000,000. Contemporaneous TP documentation is strongly recommended below the threshold for IP-heavy hyper-casual game publishers.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 apply. A hyper-casual gaming IC deriving advertising revenue through AdMob and AppLovin engages in the relevant activity of intellectual property holding and the provision of headquarters/advertising monetization services. The IC must maintain a physical registered office and registered agent in Samoa, employ adequate qualified personnel physically present in Samoa, hold board meetings and make strategic decisions in Samoa, and perform its core income-generating activities in Samoa, including counterparty contracting, advertising inventory pricing, and revenue governance. Non-compliance triggers ESR penalties, automatic exchange-of-information reporting, and loss of the IC tax exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Abuse of the International Company Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deriving Samoan-source income, such as contracts performed in Samoa or direct sales of in-game digital content to Samoan users, while holding the entity out as a tax-exempt IC, or willfully failing to file the required IC declaration and nil returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-assessment at 27% corporate tax on the entire income; shortfall penalty of 150% plus interest at 1.5% per month; criminal fine up to WST 100,000; imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause the IC to misdeclare are personally liable for the unpaid tax, statutory penalties, and audit costs. Courts may pierce the corporate veil to order restitution of distributions and may impose travel bans pending final assessment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a brass-plate or nominee company: no physical office, no staff in Samoa, all board decisions made remotely, and advertising monetization income flowing as a passive conduit without local management or operational substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR civil penalty up to WST 100,000 per relevant activity; suspension of the IC tax residence status and final deregistration by the Registrar of International Companies for continued non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the Samoa-resident registered agent are jointly liable for ESR penalties. Personal travel bans and restrictions on leaving Samoa may be imposed while the substance infringement is investigated.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the ultimate beneficial owner of the hyper-casual gaming entity, failing to maintain a beneficial ownership register, or routing AdMob and AppLovin payouts through opaque nominee arrangements contrary to Samoa's AML/CFT Act 2019.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Body corporate fine up to WST 2,000,000 per incident; disqualification of the registered agent; asset seizure and bank account freezing ordered by the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual money-laundering offences are punishable by imprisonment up to 14 years. Directors are exposed to civil restitution claims by the Financial Intelligence Unit and confiscation of proceeds derived from the concealed gaming revenue.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing advertising inventory, user-acquisition services, or IP royalties in related-party transactions at artificial rates that leave no profit in Samoa, or parking excess margin in a zero-tax IC without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer-pricing adjustment by the Ministry of Revenue to the arm's-length price; reclassification of undeclared profits as deemed dividends subject to 15% withholding tax; penalty of 100% of the adjusted tax amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or instruct distorted intercompany agreements are jointly and severally liable with the IC for the adjustment and penalties, and may face criminal sanctions for false statements made in tax filings.
